checks: weather on a phone: the hours sit side by side, legible, and the card draws no backdrop blur
voice: Verse says what it thinks of itself, in its own words, with what it has asked for and how many of its asks were built
voice: the reflection card shows what got built as a bar (2 of 5, 40%) and each ask opens to when Verse asked it and that it is not built yet
WebMCP: a miss from an agent call is tagged origin agent; the same miss typed by a person is not
paid: signed out, a price question says the membership line AND opens the services card under it

worldtime: takes no other skill's examples (collision)

self-grounding: "what's next" is answered from Verse's own facts (open inbox rows, skills, the will), with no Wikipedia lookup and no 7-day cache
self-grounding: with the model busy or switched off, a self ask gets Verse's own facts, never a Wikipedia extract
undo pile: a dismissed sticky is on the pile, a restore button and "restore the last dismissed" put it back, and "what changed today" lists the adds and the dismissals

favorites and bookmarks: "favorite this" puts a star on the picked card, "bookmark: make a clock" keeps the ask, "my bookmarks" lists both and a run button asks it again; "recently kept" with nothing kept says so
